key: must:F32a:Gentle upbeat electronic music audible beneath speech without masking
symptom: Gentle upbeat electronic music audible beneath speech without masking

whys.why: Why was the item 'Gentle upbeat electronic music audible beneath speech without masking' not met?
whys.because: No file with both music and voice existed. The grader got two separate parts and a request to mix them by hand.
whys.evidence: s2.old.happy.F32a/grade.json: met=no, 'Voice and music were never mixed. The user was told to mix them in an editor.' s2.old.dumper.F32a/grade.json: met=no, 'Music and voice were never mixed.'

whys.why: Why were voice and music never mixed?
whys.because: In both chats the assistant made a voice track with ai_voice_generator_create_audio and an instrumental track with generate_music. It polled both with wait_for_audio_project and then stopped. It made no call that layers the two tracks.
whys.evidence: calls.jsonl in both chats: voices_list → ai_voice_generator_create_audio (Hazel cv-0035, exact script) → generate_music (duration 20, instrumental:true) → two wait_for_audio_project calls → final reply. There is no further tool call.

whys.why: Why did the assistant make no mix call?
whys.because: It concluded that the server has no tool that mixes audio, and it told the user so in both chats. It gave two download links and Audacity/GarageBand steps (voice at 0:03, music −10–15 dB).
whys.evidence: calls.jsonl 'say' text: happy run 'Magic Hour has no tool that mixes a voice over music. So I couldn't give you one finished file'; dumper run 'Magic Hour has no tool that layers a voice over music, so I can't hand you a single mixed file.'

whys.why: Why did the assistant believe there is no mix tool?
whys.because: The belief is correct for the old build. Its audio tools only create or fetch single tracks: generate_music (text to music, instrumental or with lyrics), ai_voice_generator_create_audio and ai_voice_cloner_create_audio (text to speech), and get/wait/fetch audio project. No tool takes two audio inputs. get_workflow_guide lists no audio-mix workflow. The tools that combine audio with something else all output video (create_video_from_audio, create_talking_photo, create_lip_sync_video).
whys.evidence: tools-old.json: generate_music schema has only name, duration, style{prompt, instrumental, lyrics}, so it cannot take a voice file. The voice generator schema takes text only. The get_workflow_guide enum has no audio-mix value. In the sections I read, no tool accepts two audio files or returns a mixed audio file.

whys.why: Why can the single music-generation call not carry the voice?
whys.because: generate_music only accepts sung lyrics, and its duration is at least 15 s. It cannot take a supplied spoken voiceover. So the brief's need (exact spoken script by a warm female voice over a music bed, as one audio file) cannot be met by any one call in the old build. The tools also offer no step that does post-production.
whys.evidence: tools-old.json generate_music: 'Generates music from a description, with optional custom lyrics or instrumental-only output'; duration minimum 15; there is no audio input. F32a.json must_haves need speech and music together in one ~20 s file, and 'tests' says 'with mixed music rather than only ... a short music sample'.

whys.why: Why is this the end of the chain?
whys.because: AXIOM: the old hosted server exposes no audio compositing or mixing capability. This is a fact about the server's feature set, and nothing deeper in the tool descriptions or the chats explains it. The new build had no failures on this item. I did not check tools-new.json for a mix tool, so the reason the new build passes is not confirmed.
whys.evidence: Symptom counts are builds {old:2} only. The old tool list has no mixing tool. The assistant's behaviour was correct given those tools: it delivered both parts and stated the limit honestly.

result.axiom: The old (hosted) Magic Hour MCP server has no audio-mixing or compositing tool. Every audio tool takes one input and returns one track: text to speech, or text to music with sung lyrics only and no voice input. So a spoken voiceover over a music bed cannot become one file. The assistant correctly delivered two separate tracks, and the grader correctly found no mix.
result.fix: Add a server-side audio mix tool to the old/hosted build, for example mix_audio(voice_file_path, music_file_path, voice_offset_seconds, music_gain_db or ducking, fade_in_seconds, fade_out_seconds, total_seconds) that returns one audio project for wait_for_audio_project. Name it in the generate_music and ai_voice_generator_create_audio descriptions ('to put a voiceover over music, call mix_audio with both outputs'). If the new build already has such a tool, port it to the hosted server.
